title: an untrusted folder is refused even when no trust dialog shows: no dialog is no pass
source: intended: owner decision, defect N-22: the folder Orca reports is checked on every launch
intent: INTENDED behavior (owner decision, defect N-22). The folder Orca reports is compared with the worktrees of the repo on every launch, whether or not the trust dialog shows. A folder outside the repo exits 2, closes the terminal, writes no registry line and leaves no launch folder.
